applicabilityBasis.summary: AED-RAKBANK is a pre-launch dirham-backed payment token planned for 1:1 AED redemption under CBUAE oversight.

genius.issuerEntity: The National Bank of Ras Al Khaimah P.S.C. (RAKBank)
genius.notes: RAKBank has announced CBUAE in-principle approval for an AED payment token, but no U.S. GENIUS PPSI approval, official application, OCC foreign-issuer registration or Treasury comparability determination was found in the reviewed sources and searches as of 2026-10-07. The January 7 issuer-supplied press release remains conditional on completion of regulatory and operational requirements. It describes planned 1:1 AED reserves, par redemption and real-time attestations, rather than a published operating reserve report, binding holder redemption policy or monthly attestation series. The existing issuerEntity is retained verbatim as the announced bank sponsor/issuer; no separate token issuing vehicle is named. Domestic CBUAE oversight establishes no U.S. GENIUS pathway. Primary issuer implementation remains proposed; the September 30 SCRC procedural rule does not approve an issuer or make the Act effective. The DASP field records the pre-effective GENIUS posture only.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-07, no public token-specific PPSI approval, official GENIUS application, state-qualified approval, OCC foreign-issuer registration, Treasury foreign comparability determination or GENIUS enforcement action was located for AED-RAKBANK / RAKBank. The reviewed primary issuer-implementation materials are proposals. The September 30 SCRC procedural rule does not approve an issuer. This bounded negative-evidence review does not prove that no private filing exists.
